title: Fujita 2000 AF cube equilibrium shear modulus G23

quantity.name: equilibrium shear modulus G23
quantity.definition: shear modulus perpendicular to lamella, vertical plane; equilibrium after 20 min relaxation

source.authors: Fujita Y, Wagner DR, Biviji AA, Duncan NA, Lotz JC
source.sample: 30 AF cube specimens (3.2 mm) + 56/58 lamellar sheet specimens from non-degenerate (grade I-II) lumbar discs of 6 + 6 spines
source.age: cubes: 35, 67, 71 y + 3 unknown; sheets: 36, 71, 82 y + 3 unknown

protocol.summary: 3.2+-0.15 mm AF cubes (anterior and posterolateral) cut in chilled physiologic saline; simple shear in three planes (G12: perpendicular to lamella, parallel to horizontal plane; G23: perpendicular to lamella, parallel to spinal axis; G31: in the lamellar plane); preconditioning 5 cycles at 0.4 Hz to +-3% shear strain; stepwise shear strain 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10% each held 20 min; equilibrium (relaxed) shear stress vs strain, slope = time-independent shear modulus; both directions.
how_to_simulate: Model a 3.2 mm AF cube with local fibre architecture
Apply simple shear in the stated plane in 2.5% steps to 10%, relax to equilibrium
Report equilibrium shear stress / shear strain slope

extraction.check_notes: Table values from text layer (digital publisher PDF), mean +- SD. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
